unlisted_practices: Generating clinical justifications/rationales alongside LLM classification labels to make suicide phenotyping interpretable

screen.reason: Evaluates reasoning LLMs (GPT-4o, o1, o3-mini) for automated clinical suicide phenotyping and justification generation on retrospective clinical notes without testing deployment safeguards or comparing workflow practices.
